# 10Adventures

> > 10Adventures provides GPS-guided walking tours, hiking trails, and self-drive adventure itineraries across global destinations including Boston, London, NYC, and Costa Rica.

The platform offers both a mobile trails app with offline GPS tracking and custom travel planning services, featuring urban walking routes and outdoor adventures with detailed difficulty ratings and downloadable guides.

## Key Topics

- City walking tours
- GPS-guided trails
- Self-drive adventures
- Boston urban hiking
- London walking routes
- New York City tours
- Costa Rica itineraries
- Trails mobile app
- Offline maps
- Custom travel itineraries
- Adventure tourism
- Difficulty ratings
- Urban exploration
- Downloadable guides
- Travel booking

## Getting Started

- [10Adventures: Find Your Next Adventure](https://www.10adventures.com/): Homepage for hiking trails, adventure tours & custom travel itineraries
- [Get the app!](https://www.10adventures.com/trails-app/): Mobile app for GPS tracking, downloadable maps & trail guides

## City Walking Tours

- [Best City Walks l City Walking Tours l 10Adventures](https://www.10adventures.com/city-walks/): City walking tours in Boston, London, NYC with GPS guides & routes

## Adventure Tours

- [Self-Drive Adventure Tours](https://www.10adventures.com/tours/self-drive-tours/): Self-guided driving tours in Costa Rica, Arenal & worldwide destinations
